thread:
mike: Kickoff for Harbor model onboarding. Need to lock launch gates: bench pass, pin options, and pricing delta. Can we keep this lightweight for the pilot?
rebecca: Quick notes from ML: require p99 <= 450ms on seq256 for Hosted API; cold-start (first token) <= 180ms. Embedding recall @K10 >= 0.88 on our L2 dataset. Also run a synthetic adversarial prompt set for hallucination checks.
tony: Ops constraints: Dedicated capacity for pilot might need reserved GPUs. Recommend capacity uplift estimate +25% for warm pools. That affects pricing.
lina: Product suggestion: staggered pin windows instead of binary pin/unpin. Proposal:
- default: 14d soft-pin (auto-notify, quick canary)
- standard: 60d managed pin (manual ops, included in paid pilot)
- enterprise: 180d contractual pin (SLA + support)
This gives gradations for customers and reduces ops churn. :scale:
rebecca: For bench criteria also capture token-efficiency (tokens/sec) and model-variant delta: quantized-int8 vs float16 deviance <= 1.5% on quality metrics.
ben: Pricing thought: we can offer a "pin add-on" with a flat monthly fee + per-token uplift. Example calc: baseline COGS $0.28/1k; pin add-on increases infra COGS to $0.35/1k -> price at 2.2x margin for pilot. Need final numbers from finance.
mike: Rollout plan idea:
1) CI bench (seq64/256) -> green
2) internal canary (alpha tenants) 24h
3) controlled pilot (3 customers, sampled traffic) 7 days
4) expand pilot cohort
Snippet for tagging telemetry we want:
```
# attach tags in gateway
tags = [f"model:harbor-v1", f"pin:{pin_window}", f"variant:{quant}" ]
```
rebecca: Metric instrumentation: add "pin_window" dimension to Console so we can slice latency/cost by pin cohort. Also track "fallback_count" for auto-rollbacks.
tony: Runbook: auto-fallback if p99 regression >12% sustained for 3h OR error rate spike >1% absolute. Fallback targets: harbor-lite-v1 or last-stable. Include contact matrix.
lina: Customer comms: pilot customers should get a pre-onboard note with expected metrics, pin options, and how rollbacks are handled. I'll draft a template.
ben: Finance: I'll model revenue impact and send a short deck. Need expected token volumes per customer.
mike: Decision needed Wednesday on pin windows and bench thresholds to finalize invites. Who owns what?
rebecca: I'll own ML benches + adversarial tests.
tony: Ops takes capacity calc + runbook.
lina: Product owns comms and pilot invites.
ben: Finance owns pricing deck.
ops-bot: CI pipeline trigger: bench-harbor-v1 -> queued. ETA 45m.
mike: Great. I'll post a one-pager and schedule a 30m sync if any blockers arise. :calendar:
